summary.title: Summary & Export

autoBriefings.label: Auto-generate briefings
autoBriefings.description: Generate all four briefing types as soon as you open a finished session. Off by default: briefings are generated when you ask for them, one type at a time.

highStakes.label: High-stakes summaries
highStakes.description: Two-pass summarization for legal, notarial, and other accuracy-critical work. The model first extracts every name, date, figure, and commitment from the transcript, then writes the summary anchored to those facts. Slower and uses more tokens than the standard path, but reduces missed or rewritten details.

profile.label: Professional Profile
profile.description: Sets the emphasis for new summaries. It does not give advice or verify claims.

general_professional.label: General Professional
general_professional.description: Emphasizes decisions, commitments, blockers, and open questions.

legal.label: Legal
legal.description: Emphasizes claims, obligations, disputed facts, and evidence.

investment_analysis.label: Investment Analysis
investment_analysis.description: Emphasizes figures, forecasts, assumptions, risks, and diligence gaps.

journalism.label: Journalism
journalism.description: Emphasizes attribution, claims, verification gaps, and follow-up questions.

negotiation.label: Negotiation
negotiation.description: Emphasizes offers, conditions, concessions, and agreed versus open points.

decision_committee.label: Decision Committee
decision_committee.description: Emphasizes proposals, approvals, conditions, dissents, and follow-ups.

investigation.label: Investigation
investigation.description: Emphasizes chronology, admissions, denials, evidence references, and inconsistencies.

retention.title: Live Recording Audio Retention
retention.description: Automatically delete original audio files created by live recording. Transcripts and summaries remain available.
retention.loadError: Unable to load recording retention settings.

enabled.label: Auto-delete live recording audio
enabled.description: Permanently delete the stored audio from this server after the selected period. Copies in existing backups remain until those backups are deleted.

days.label: Delete after
days.description: Choose between 1 and 30 days after live recording completion.

applyExisting.label: Apply to existing live recordings
applyExisting.description: Also delete audio from completed live recordings that are already older than the selected period.

preview.count: {{count}} live recordings have audio eligible for immediate deletion.

confirm.label: Confirm immediate delete count
confirm.description: Enter {{count}} to confirm immediate permanent audio deletion.
